India Exports First Gasoline Cargo to Russia Amid Refinery Issues

India has exported its first gasoline cargo to Russia, a move occurring as Russian refineries face damage from Ukrainian attacks. This marks a significant shift, with Russia, historically a crude oil exporter, now importing gasoline. The transaction involves India supplying gasoline to Russia for the first time.
